messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t tell you who else bought the hose reel or whether they returned theirs. Your order’s return records show the garden hose reel was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Would you like me to help request a refund for it?
